There was a bill numbered 1189, which is authorizing a version of tax increment financing. That's something that the city of Lakewood has advocated for for years. And one of the things that the city is hoping that these dollars can be used toward is preparation of the infrastructure for Lakewood Landing, which is the 30 acre mixed use multi-phased development that is now being advertised to developers nationally that's located next to or pretty close to the Lakewood Station and is within that Lakewood Station sub area plan that was just adopted. The bill numbered 5287 has a number of affordable housing incentives, which are being tweaked. This relates to the city's multifamily tax exemption.
